title: BlobReference ($blob)
description: Reference a store writes in place of a JSON value larger than 16 KiB (BLOB_THRESHOLD). Rust: crates/agentscope-durable/src/store/file.rs::{blob_reference, blob_reference_of}; the object store that serves the same layout is crates/agentscope-durable-objects. The shape is matched strictly: `$blob` must be the only key, `kind` is the one representation the store writes, `bytes` is a number and `digest` is 64 hex characters, so a value whose own JSON happens to carry a `$blob` field keeps being read as data.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the stored payload; the file name is <digest>.json, so the name is the content and a write is idempotent.

bytes.description: Payload length in bytes before encoding.

kind.description: BLOB_KIND: the payload is the JSON encoding of the value.
